title: Christian Christmas Ornament SVG Bundle
author: yasushimuraki
description:
Celebrate the true meaning of Christmas with this beautiful Christian Christmas Ornament SVG Bundle. This collection features three faith-inspired wooden ornaments: a peaceful white dove holding an olive branch, a praying figure with a glowing halo, and praying hands surrounded by radiant light. Each design is set on a rustic wooden cross and combines warm wood textures with elegant layered details for a meaningful holiday decoration.
Perfect for decorating your Christmas tree, creating thoughtful handmade gifts, or adding a spiritual touch to your seasonal home decor. These designs are ideal for DIY crafters who love creating personalized wooden ornaments and religious keepsakes.
✨ WHAT’S INCLUDED
3 Christian Christmas ornament designs
Dove with olive branch and wooden cross
Praying figure with halo and cross
Praying hands with radiant light and cross
Digital files for laser cutting and crafting
🎄 PERFECT FOR
Christmas tree decorations
Christian Christmas decor
Religious holiday ornaments
Church Christmas decorations
Faith-inspired handmade gifts
Personalized wooden keepsakes
DIY Christmas craft projects
📁 FILE FORMATS
AI, EPS, SVG, DXF, PDF, DWG
🛠️ COMPATIBILITY
Suitable for compatible laser cutting machines and design software, including Glowforge, xTool, OMTech, CNC machines, and LightBurn.
